controls: exact packet hash is required as an explicit authorization argument
a separate owner authorization record must be active and bound to the packet hash
one HTTPS POST, zero retries and zero redirects
adapter-canonical request digest is recomputed before transport
public address pinning and TLS hostname verification are used
response is limited to 2 MiB and must be JSON with HTTP 200
case-level and personal-data boundaries are enforced by the adapter
raw response is retained only in process memory and never written
dry-run verifies bindings without network access
terminal failures are written as non-retryable receipts even when a POST may have started
limitations: No provider call or response receipt exists until the owner authorizes the exact packet.
This preparation does not establish semantic equivalence, rights clearance, L2 maturity, G2 acceptance, publication or release.
